Name: Sam's Better Band Events
Author: AirynS
Description:
[size=3]Sam's band events have never made much sense to me. Is Sam really willing to change his entire musical direction based on the preferences of an acquaintance? Does anyone really think that Sebastian would be fine with playing country music? Why is Abigail never mentioned?

This mod makes light edits to Sam's 2, 3, and 8 heart events so that they:
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]acknowledge that Abigail exists and is also part of the band[/size]
[*][size=3]have both Sam and Sebastian give their thoughts on the music advice[/size]
[*][size=3]have Sam thank his bandmates and parents instead of solely attributing the band's success to the player[/size]
[*][size=3]give details about the song Sam's band plays (unique for each music genre!)[/size]
[*][size=3]and in general feel a little less awkward and more about the band instead of the player.[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[/size][size=3]Should be compatible with any other mods that don't touch Sam's 2 and 8 heart events and is likely incompatible with other mods that do. [size=3]You may translate this mod as long as AI is not used to translate and only the translated i18n folder is uploaded.

[b]If you install this mid-save when you've already seen Sam's 2 heart event but haven't yet seen his 8 heart event, you will get the mod's default response, [/b]which is the "experimental noise rock" version. To change this, type `debug ebi 44` into the SMAPI console in order to replay Sam's 2 heart event and select the response you want.[/size]

To install, simply download and extract the "[CP] Sam's Better Band Events" folder from the zip, then drop it in your Mods folder. Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8146]Platonic Partners and Friendships[/url]﻿.

Seasonal outfits mod used in screenshots is [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17059]Diverse Stardew Valley[/url].

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36559]Dynamic Sam Three Heart Event Updated[/url].[/size]
